pages.title: Korok Waving Beside the Ferns in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok waves beside ferns in Korok Forest in this printable coloring page, with a large lobed leaf mask and a rounded body marked by wood-grain lines. Raised twig fingers, a small trunk knot, and fine leaf veins provide details around the broad mask, while a tree trunk and fern fronds frame the figure.

pages.title: Three Koroks Gathered Around the Master Sword Pedestal in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows three Koroks gathered around the Master Sword pedestal in Korok Forest, with raised twig arms and differently shaped leaf masks. The sword's winged guard and wrapped grip rise above a Triforce-marked stone base, while cracked rocks, leafy plants, and a large tree create the surrounding forest sections.

pages.title: Korok Appearing Beside a Completed Circle of Stones on a Grassy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok appears beside a completed circle of stones on a grassy hill in this printable coloring page, lifting both twig arms beneath a pointed leaf mask. Vein lines and a knot in the wooden body add fine character details, while the rounded stones, scattered grass, distant cliffs, and mountain provide larger outlined shapes.

pages.title: Korok Beside Three Apple Trees with Matching Fruit in a Hyrule Orchard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Korok beside three apple trees with matching fruit in a Hyrule orchard, raising leafy hands beneath a lobed mask. Large apples and rounded tree crowns provide open areas above smaller grass tufts, while a rail fence, mountain outlines, and distant castle spires complete the scene.

pages.title: Korok Beside Apple Offerings in Front of Stone Statues on a Mountain Path Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok stands beside apple offerings on a mountain path in this printable coloring page, with two weathered stone statues rising behind its pointed leaf mask. Three apples rest on a flat rock, while the statues' closed eyes, chest emblems, surface cracks, and surrounding grass provide smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Korok Beside a Completed Metal Cube Pattern Among Stone Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Korok beside a completed metal cube pattern among stone ruins, with both twig arms extended toward the decorated block. Circular centers and angular bands divide the cube's visible faces, while a cracked stone arch, broken pillar, and irregular paving add larger structural sections around the character.

pages.title: Korok Beside a Spinning Pinwheel with Target Balloons Above a Cliff Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok stands beside a spinning pinwheel above a cliff in this printable coloring page, with three target balloons floating overhead beyond the grassy edge. Concentric balloon rings, folded pinwheel blades, and the Korok's veined leaf mask form separate coloring areas, while cracked cliff faces and distant mountains add background detail.

pages.title: Korok Appearing at the Final Blossom of a Flower Trail Through Ruined Pillars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Korok appearing at the final blossom of a flower trail, raising both arms between ruined pillars on a stone terrace. A large foreground flower displays rounded petals and upright stamens, while smaller blooms, cracked columns, and the Korok's leaf veins provide varied enclosed sections.

pages.title: Korok Emerging From a Trail of Swirling Leaves in a Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok emerges from swirling leaves in a forest clearing in this printable coloring page, holding both arms out beneath a large pointed leaf mask. Curved motion lines trace the airborne leaves around the figure, while wood-grain marks, fine leaf veins, rocks, and grass tufts add detail between the tree trunks.

pages.title: Korok Beside a Small Rock Uncovered Beneath a Pile of Fallen Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Korok beside a small rock uncovered beneath fallen leaves, with both twig hands raised beside the scattered pile on the ground. Jagged leaf edges and fine veins create detailed sections around the rounded rock, while the Korok's broad mask and wood-grain body provide larger spaces.

pages.title: Korok Appearing Beside Link After He Catches a Falling Dandelion Bud in a Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok appears beside Link after he catches a falling dandelion bud in this printable coloring page, with Link kneeling among meadow flowers and grass. The feathery seed head spreads above his raised hand, while belt buckles, patterned bracers, and the Korok's leaf mask supply smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Korok Beside a Newly Roofed Shelter Protecting a Stone Statue at the Roadside Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Korok beside a newly roofed roadside shelter, with a seated stone statue protected beneath the pitched roof and timber supports. Rope lashings and overlapping roof boards add narrow details above the statue's closed eyes and folded hands, while rocks and grass surround the small leaf-masked figure.

pages.title: Korok Greeting Link on a Leaf-marked Tree Stump After a Sky Island Gliding Challenge Coloring Page
pages.description: A Korok greets Link on a leaf-marked stump after a Sky Island gliding challenge in this printable coloring page, lifting both arms as Link waves. Growth rings circle the leaf emblem beneath the Korok, while Link's decorated shield, patterned sleeve, and distant floating ruins add distinct sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Korok Beside a Boulder Balanced on a Three-branched Tree Stump Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Korok beside a boulder balanced on a three-branched stump, raising its arms below the cracked rock and cut branch ends. Leaf veins, wood-grain lines, and a large trunk knot add finer details, with broad boulder faces and scattered grass providing more open coloring areas.

pages.title: Hestu the Korok Shaking His Maracas in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Hestu shakes his maracas in Korok Forest in this printable coloring page, with a broad leafy beard, branching crown, and small pouch across his rounded body. Circular and leaf-shaped maraca patterns add enclosed details, while sweeping bark lines, surrounding tree trunks, and grass tufts complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hestu the Korok Dancing with Three Small Korok Backup Dancers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hestu dancing with three small Korok backup dancers, raising patterned maracas while one leg lifts above the grass and rocks. The smaller Koroks hold leafy twigs, and motion marks surround their arms. Hestu's broad canopy, leafy beard, and flower-decorated pouch create larger sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Makar the Korok Practicing His Violin Behind the Waterfall at Forest Haven Coloring Page
pages.description: Makar practices his violin behind the Forest Haven waterfall in this printable coloring page, standing on a rocky ledge between two curtains of falling water. Fine strings, tuning pegs, and a diagonal bow detail the instrument, while large droplets and leaf-mask veins add smaller sections around his rounded body.

pages.title: Makar the Korok Flying Across a Wind Temple Gap with His Leaf Propeller Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Makar flying across a Wind Temple gap with his leaf propeller, suspended between stone platforms above curling clouds and carved masonry. Two large veined leaves spread over his head, while his heart-shaped mask, small twig arms, patterned platform edges, and bird-shaped stone ornament add distinct details.

pages.title: Makar Playing Violin Beside Link and a Giant Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Makar returns with Link to the Great Deku Tree after his Forbidden Woods rescue in this printable coloring page, carrying his violin and bow beside Link. The tree's large face fills the background, while Link's pointed cap, shoulder strap, belt buckle, and Makar's leaf veins provide smaller details around the pair.

pages.title: Makar Playing Violin with Three Koroks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Makar playing his violin for gathered Koroks at the Forest Haven ceremony, standing on a round stump beneath hanging leaf decorations. Three smaller Koroks watch from below, while strings, bow details, mask veins, and stump growth rings create finer sections beside the broad tree trunks.

pages.title: Wind Waker Korok Carrying a Great Deku Tree Seed While Flying Above the Great Sea Coloring Page
pages.description: A Wind Waker Korok carries a Great Deku Tree seed above the Great Sea in this printable coloring page, gripping the large spiral-marked seed overhead. Three pointed leaves rise from its top, while the Korok's veined mask, small islands, outlined clouds, and waves add detail around the broad central shapes.

pages.title: Hollo the Korok Brewing a Potion From Boko Baba Seeds in the Forest Potion Shop Coloring Page
